welcome_title: Welcome to the SAS Nordic Team!
welcome_p1: The SAS Nordic Team is a regional association of Swiss-Ski that is open to students who are passionate about nordic skiing competitions. In the summer, we offer training camps and coaching, and in the winter, our athletes compete in various competitions. Our main focus is on cross-country skiing, for which we provide professional support for the Swiss Cup racing series.
welcome_p2: Additionally, we also promote athletes in other Nordic sports such as biathlon, ski orienteering, Nordic combined, and ski jumping, although we do not provide specific training and competition support for these disciplines.
what_item_1: Monthly training camps from June to November
what_item_2: Race support including waxing and accommodation
what_item_3: Individual coaching for technique and training
offer_comp_alt: SAS Nordic Team at a competition
who_item_1: FIS athletes pursuing a dual career
who_item_2: Ex-FIS athletes starting an academic path who would like to stay attached with racing
who_item_3: Ambitious students (mass sport) when free spots are available
comp_item_2: Selected FESA Cup races, sometimes in collaboration with other teams
comp_item_5: SAS Events such as the Pentathlon
wwug_photo_alt: Cross country skiers at the Universiade
wwug_p1: The Universiade is the Olympic Games for university students. In close collaboration with Swiss University Sports, SAS is involved in the support of the Nordic disciplines.
wwug_criteria_item_1: Enrolled at a university or college
wwug_criteria_item_3: Fulfillment of the {performance_criteria_link} set by Swiss University Sports
wwug_contact_p: For applications, please contact {marcel_ott_link}, the Nordic Coordinator at Swiss University Sports.
